name: Electronic sources of the literary texts (850 entries)
licence_name: Individual licence per source
version: Per entry
what_we_use: Every Latin, Greek, English, Coptic, Hebrew, Persian and Urdu text in the corpus.
notes: The table at the foot of the Text Credits page names the electronic source and print source of every work, and the licence terms of the few restricted works.

name: Aligned translations in the Reader
licence_name: Public domain, or open non-commercial with attribution
version: Per work
what_we_use: The English translations shown beside Latin and Greek works in the Reader's Translation tab.
notes: The translator of each work is listed on the Text Credits page. Most are public domain. A few are used with attribution under the translator's non-commercial terms (Silius Italicus, Punica 9 to 17, A. S. Kline) and are not in our data releases.

name: Epigraphic Database Heidelberg (EDH)
licence_name: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 (CC BY-SA 4.0)
version: github.com/epigraphic-database-heidelberg/data, commit 45f166654ab4551a1954617a0df8e56fa7724ccb
what_we_use: Inscription texts, dates, findspots and metadata from the EpiDoc files in inscriptions/ (the bibliography, geography and image folders were not taken).
notes: Repository: https://github.com/epigraphic-database-heidelberg/data. Its README states: "All data can be reused under the CC BY_SA 4.0 licence."

name: papyri.info: Duke Databank of Documentary Papyri (DDbDP) and Heidelberg Gesamtverzeichnis (HGV)
licence_name: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 (CC BY 3.0), with copyright and attribution to the respective projects
version: github.com/papyri/idp.data, commit 0ee26759335668815608c0aed2efb16159116fe8
what_we_use: Papyrus and ostracon texts (DDbDP, 67,980 texts) and their dates, findspots and bibliography (HGV, 68,022 metadata records).
notes: Repository: https://github.com/papyri/idp.data. Its README states: "This data is made available under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 License, with copyright and attribution to the respective projects."

name: I.Sicily: Inscriptions of Sicily
licence_name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0)
version: github.com/ISicily/ISicily, commit 572d7f5ee1cbb62087bfed3c46ffc7cab6cb386c
what_we_use: Inscription texts and metadata from the inscriptions/ folder (about 1,000 files at the time of retrieval).
notes: Repository: https://github.com/ISicily/ISicily. The project states: "All data in I.Sicily is available for download and re-use under a CC-BY 4.0 licence." The repository is under continuous revision.

name: Epigraphic Database Roma (EDR)
licence_name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0), the licence of the Zenodo deposit
version: Zenodo deposit, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.18468635 (export of 2026-02-03)
what_we_use: Inscription texts and metadata from the full export (115,591 XML files).
notes: The licence is the Zenodo record's. The TEI headers inside the files still carry the older EDR wording "Reserved Rights - Free access via Epigraphic Database Roma"; the deposit licence governs this export. Record page: https://zenodo.org/records/18468635.

name: Pleiades: a community-built gazetteer of ancient places
licence_name: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 (CC BY 3.0)
version: pleiades-places-latest.json.gz, downloaded 2026-10-07 (the current places dump; also EDH's own edhPleiadesGeonames.csv for findspot links)
what_we_use: Place identifiers and names for document findspots, and the link from each document to its Pleiades page. I.Sicily and papyri.info/HGV link to Pleiades directly. The Help page also names the Pleiades gazetteer as one source of the Greek-Latin name pairs.
notes: The downloads page states: "Sharing and remixing permitted under terms of the Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 License (cc-by)."

name: Trismegistos
licence_name: No Trismegistos data files are copied. Only place identifiers are used, as cited inside EDH files (CC BY-SA 4.0) and the Pleiades dump (CC BY 3.0).
version: Identifiers only
what_we_use: Trismegistos place numbers, read from EDH's own files, to join an EDH or EDR findspot to a Pleiades place (scripts/documents/places_crosswalk.py).
notes: Trismegistos terms of use could not be read when this record was written (the site returned an access check to our automated request), so no Trismegistos licence is claimed.

name: Commentaries from the Perseus Digital Library (open-source TEI distribution)
licence_name: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 United States (CC BY-SA 3.0 US)
version: Each commentary file records its own source URL and commit
what_we_use: Commentary notes shown in the Reader's Scholarship tab: Servius on Vergil; Conington and Nettleship on the Aeneid; the anonymous commentary on Ovid's Heroides; Simmons on Metamorphoses XIII-XIV; Donkin on Cicero Pro Roscio Amerino; Merrill on Catullus; Shorey on Horace; Gildersleeve on Pindar; Monro on the Odyssey XIII-XXIV; Merry and Riddell on the Odyssey I-XII; Seymour on the Iliad I-VI; Leaf on the Iliad; Allen and Sikes on the Homeric Hymns; Jebb on Sophocles Ajax; Cope on Aristotle's Rhetoric; How and Wells on Herodotus; Goodwin on Demosthenes On the Crown; Paley and Sandys on Demosthenes private orations; Sharpley on the Olynthiacs.
notes: Taken through the CLTK mirrors https://github.com/cltk/lat_text_perseus and https://github.com/cltk/grc_text_perseus. Because the licence is share-alike, these notes stay under CC BY-SA 3.0 US.

name: Commentaries from the Internet Archive (public-domain editions)
licence_name: Public domain (published before 1930; the Variorum Spenser volumes are recorded as copyright not renewed)
version: Each commentary file records its own source URL and commit
what_we_use: Notes from Greenlaw, Osgood and Padelford's Variorum Spenser; A. W. Verity on Milton; David Masson on Milton; E. de Selincourt on Keats and on Wordsworth's Prelude; G. W. Kitchin on The Faerie Queene; T. E. Page on Vergil; Papillon and Haigh on Vergil; W. Aldis Wright and W. G. Clark on Shakespeare.
notes: The Internet Archive terms page is linked as the general terms of the host. The status of each edition is recorded in its file.

name: Commentaries served by Sefaria
licence_name: As stated by Sefaria for each text (Public Domain, CC0, CC-BY or CC-BY-NC)
version: Each commentary file records its own source URL and commit
what_we_use: Rashi, Radak, Ramban, Ralbag, Sforno, Malbim, Ibn Ezra, Metzudat David and Metzudat Zion on the Hebrew Bible, in Hebrew and English as Sefaria serves them. The Scholarship tab also links the Sefaria commentary page for a verse.
notes: Each file records Sefaria's licence for the Hebrew and for the translation. Where a text is CC-BY-NC it is used for non-commercial purposes only. The Sefaria terms page returned an access error to our automated request; the address is Sefaria's published terms page and is not checked.

name: Matthew Henry, Commentary on the Whole Bible (Christian Classics Ethereal Library edition)
licence_name: Public domain (as recorded by CCEL)
version: Each commentary file records its own source URL and commit
what_we_use: Commentary notes on all 66 books of the Bible.

name: JSTOR Early Journal Content, via the Internet Archive
licence_name: Pre-1923 journal articles released by JSTOR as Early Journal Content
version: Live service, queried at request time
what_we_use: The site's own offline index of passage citations in journals from before 1923. The Scholarship tab shows the citing article and where it cites.
notes: Only citations (article, passage) are shown, never the article text. Index built offline into data/citation_index/citations.db. The JSTOR Early Journal Content terms page could not be checked at the address we tried, so its wording is not quoted.

name: OpenAlex
licence_name: Free API; see the service's own terms
version: Live service, queried at request time
what_we_use: Articles, chapters and books that cite a passage, searched by title and abstract.
notes: We did not verify the licence wording when writing this record.

name: Crossref
licence_name: Metadata largely not subject to copyright and free to use for any purpose; abstracts may be copyrighted
version: Live service, queried at request time
what_we_use: Article and book metadata (title, authors, DOI) searched by title and abstract.
notes: Wording from the Crossref REST API page: "almost none of the metadata is subject to copyright, and you may use it for any purpose."

name: Semantic Scholar Academic Graph API
licence_name: Semantic Scholar API License Agreement
version: Live service, queried at request time
what_we_use: Sentences from open-access papers that mention a passage (snippet search).

name: CORE
licence_name: CORE Terms and Conditions
version: Live service, queried at request time
what_we_use: Sentences from open-access full texts that mention a passage.

name: Unpaywall
licence_name: Free API; see the service's own terms
version: Live service, queried at request time
what_we_use: The legal open-access copy of a result, when one exists.
notes: We did not verify the licence wording when writing this record.

name: Google Books API
licence_name: Google Books API Terms of Service
version: Live service, queried at request time
what_we_use: Book pages that cite a passage (title, page link, snippet as the API returns it).

name: HathiTrust Full-Text Search
licence_name: HathiTrust terms of use
version: Live service, queried at request time
what_we_use: A link that runs the same citation search in HathiTrust's book scans. We send the search; no HathiTrust data is copied or stored.
notes: The HathiTrust terms page returned an access error to our automated request, so the linked address is its home page.
